subject: Advanced telemetry bundle pricing and concession request
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@cloudlinelabs.com>
Date: 2026-09-08T10:42:00-07:00
Subject: Advanced telemetry bundle — proposal & pricing

Hi Emma,

Thanks for taking the time last week. Attached is an updated proposal based on the usage profile you shared: Cloudline-telemetry-proposal-v2.xlsx (retention tiers, tracing surcharge matrix, advanced dashboards seat pricing). High level:

- Retention: 30 / 90 / 365 day buckets with step pricing (savings at 90d and 365d).
- Tracing: base ingestion included; long-tail span retention is priced as a surcharge per 1M spans — we show a 3-tier surcharge with a blended rate for your expected volume.
- Dashboards: advanced dashboards sold as a 3-seat starter pack; extra seats billed monthly.

Pilot incentives we can offer on the hosted plan: two free dashboard seats for the first 90 days and one demo credit (up to $2k) applied to your first month.

Next steps: if you can confirm which retention bucket you want to pilot (90d vs 365d) I’ll put together a short addendum and a DocuSign link. I attached the proposal workbook for line-item review.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if you want to walk the numbers.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai
--
Attachment: Cloudline-telemetry-proposal-v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Emma Li <emma.li@cloudlinelabs.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Anders <tom.anders@cloudlinelabs.com>
Date: 2026-09-08T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Advanced telemetry bundle — proposal & pricing

Hi Mateo,

Thanks for the proposal and the clear breakdown. A couple of clarifying questions before we move to signatures:

1) For the tracing surcharge — can you confirm whether the surcharge is applied to raw spans or sampled spans? Our expected ingestion has a high raw span count but we typically sample for storage.
2) Can you share an example invoice line or two for the first three months so our finance team can model cashflow?
3) We are exploring a pilot commitment but need a one-off concession: any flexibility on discounting the telemetry add-on for the pilot (6 months) and/or waiving the tracing surcharge for the pilot start?
4) Lastly, can you provide the SOC 2 report or a security page where we can validate data separation and retention controls?

If you can surface a revised offer that includes a pilot concession, we can expedite approval on our side.

Thanks — Emma
Emma Li
Product Ops, Cloudline Labs
emma.li@cloudlinelabs.com

--
No attachments

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-08T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Cloudline pricing asks — need concession approval

Ben / Laura,

Forwarding Emma’s reply from Cloudline. They want clarity on raw vs sampled spans, a sample invoice, and are requesting a pilot concession (6 months) on telemetry add-ons and a potential waiver of the tracing surcharge to get the pilot greenlit.

Deal context: CL-2026-049, expected ARR if we convert: ~$420k year 1 (core + addons). Pilot size is modest (3 months beta, then scale to prod). Recommended starting offer to move them: 20% off telemetry add-ons for 6 months + waive tracing surcharge for first month OR 2 demo credits and two free dashboard seats for 90 days. I’m asking because this would be a one-off concession outside standard playbooks.

Attachments: Cloudline-telemetry-proposal-v2.xlsx (proposal workbook).

Can you advise approval path? If we can get to 15–25% discount territory, I think we close the pilot this week.

Cheers,
Mateo

> On 2026-09-08 at 14:05, Emma Li <emma.li@cloudlinelabs.com> wrote:
> > [see above]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Cloudline pricing asks — need concession approval

Mateo / Laura,

Thanks for the context. Given the ARR and the strategic nature (Cloudline is a strong reference target in healthtech) I’m comfortable with a constrained concession but would rather mitigate long-term margin impact. Proposed concession (approved by me):

- Telemetry add-on: 15% off months 1–6 (applies to retention + dashboards).
- Tracing surcharge: waive 50% of the surcharge for months 1–3 (not a full waiver) and revert to standard rates thereafter.
- Dashboard seats: include two free seats for the first 90 days (then bill monthly).
- Pilot cap: pilot usage capped at the projected volumes in the proposal; overages during pilot billed at standard rates to avoid open-ended exposure.

I’m attaching a short term-sheet for redline: telemetry_concession_term_sheet.pdf. We should also include a clause that any extended discount beyond month 6 requires finance sign-off and is evaluated when they convert to a committed Dedicated plan.

If Laura is ok, we can send a final offer to Emma and include a DocuSign addendum for the pilot concession.

Ben
Ben Carter
Sr. Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

Attachment: telemetry_concession_term_sheet.pdf

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@cloudlinelabs.com>, Tom Anders <tom.anders@cloudlinelabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-09T13:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Advanced telemetry bundle — proposal & pricing (final pilot offer)

Hi Emma / Tom,

Thanks for the quick turnaround. We had an internal review and can move forward with a constrained pilot concession to get you started while protecting both parties. Summary of the final offer (pilot addendum):

- Pricing: Telemetry add-on (retention + dashboards) at 15% off list for months 1–6.
- Tracing surcharge: 50% of the listed surcharge waived for months 1–3 (applies to sampled spans as outlined in the proposal workbook; raw ingestion is only billed if you elect to persist raw spans — default behavior is sampled retention).
- Dashboards: two seats included free for the first 90 days. Additional seats billed at standard monthly rates.
- Pilot cap: usage capped to the projected volumes in the attached workbook. Any overages during the pilot will be billed at standard rates (we’ll flag before charging).
- Security docs: SOC 2 report and data control matrix are available here: https://redwood.ai/security/soc2_reports/2025.

I’ve attached a final offer workbook: Cloudline-telemetry-final-offer.xlsx and opened a DocuSign addendum to capture the pilot concession: https://docusign.com/ABC-Cloudline-Addendum. If you confirm, we’ll send the addendum and schedule a short kickoff to configure the pilot workspace.

If you want an example invoice line for months 1–3 to share with finance, I can generate that and send it separately.

Would you like to lock a 30-minute kickoff tomorrow or Tuesday?

Appreciate the partnership — looking forward to the pilot.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai
